doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: Users can reset passwords via email verification. Functional requirement FR3 specifies password reset capability as part of user account management.

doc.title: Architecture Document
doc.snippet: NextAuth.js configured for session management. Password reset can be implemented as custom flow. Session management uses JWT with refresh token rotation, session expires 7 days, refresh token expires 30 days.

doc.title: Architecture Document
doc.snippet: Redis-based rate limiting infrastructure available. Configurable per endpoint. Use checkRateLimit function from src/lib/rateLimiter.ts with custom configuration for password reset (3 requests per hour per email).

doc.title: Architecture Document
doc.snippet: PostgreSQL via Supabase with Prisma ORM. SecurityEvent model available for audit logging. User model exists with email, password fields. Need to add password reset token fields or create separate PasswordResetToken model.

doc.title: Epic Breakdown
doc.snippet: Complete acceptance criteria and technical notes. Generate secure random token (32+ characters, URL-safe). Store token hash in database with expiration timestamp. Email service integration required. Token single-use (invalidate after successful reset).

doc.title: UX Design Specification
doc.snippet: ShadCN/UI Form components with react-hook-form integration. Consistent styling with design system. WCAG 2.1 Level AA compliance required. Mobile-first responsive design with breakpoints at 320px, 768px, 1024px, 1440px.

doc.title: Story 1.4: Social Authentication OAuth
doc.snippet: Auth infrastructure available: NextAuth.js configured, validation utilities at src/lib/auth/validation.ts, password validation utilities, form components established, PasswordStrengthMeter component available, error handling patterns, icon system, animation system, accessibility testing framework.
